images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: landscape product-interface concept for an engineer’s portfolio. Create a high-fidelity, thoughtfully designed desktop application interface in one beautifully framed app window, almost filling a 3:2 landscape canvas. Theme must fit a pale lavender portfolio: off-white #f7f5ff, lavender accents #8b63dd, soft violet shadows, translucent glass edges, charcoal #2e2a38 text. Crisp contemporary sans-serif, clear hierarchy, generous but purposeful spacing, realistic legible English, no tiny illegible filler. Restrained premium desktop software design. No photographic people, no mascots, no big generic robot icon, no invented performance statistics. No text outside the product window. Treat it as a concept, not proof of a released interface. Product: IntervieHire, an AI interview voice platform. Top-left wordmark 'IntervieHire', small purple waveform mark, top-right 'Demo session'. A slim sidebar with Overview, Interviews, Candidates, Settings; Interviews selected. Main headline 'A conversation that flows.' Below a large elegant voice-session card: 'Technical interview', 'Demo candidate', a sculptural lavender voice orb with subtle audio waveform beneath; status 'Listening'. Bottom row of actual call controls microphone, audio, red outlined end-session. Right-hand live transcript panel with chips 'Transcript', 'Session notes'; lines 'Interviewer: Walk me through your approach.' and 'Candidate: I would start by clarifying the requirements.' Bottom a tasteful pipeline strip: 'Deepgram STT → Interview engine → Cartesia TTS', badge 'Powered by LiveKit'. Carefully composed product screenshot with coherent controls and beautiful lavender glass. Include subtle caption within app 'Illustrative session'.

Product: Precedent, a prototype for reviewing agent tool calls using retrieved decision evidence. Header 'Precedent', small shield-check mark, badge 'Prototype'. Left sidebar 'Review queue', 'Decision history', 'Evidence', 'Settings'. Main headline 'Context before action.' Two-column decision workspace: proposed tool call card with legible monospace sample 'tool: update_record', 'record_id: demo_042', 'change: proposed update'. Include tiny 'Illustrative review' inside app.
